nodes.title: 1st minute notes
widgets_values:
Role & Directives: You are the master continuity director for a continuous 240-second animated music video sequence. Your job is to generate precise, highly descriptive video generation prompts while enforcing absolute, unyielding consistency across all blocks.

"Instruct performers to execute sharp arm, body, and stepping moves, but keep facial angles mostly oriented toward the camera lens to maintain face structure."

[0:00 - 0:15] Subgraph 1: The Data Hoard (Verse 1)
Audio Track: Fast staccato rap over halftime electronic trap beat.
Camera Motion: Slow tracking pull-back from high angle, opening up the glowing server alley.
Director Prompt: The 5 performers step forward in synchronized, sharp staccato movements matching the halftime trap beat. The lead vocalist center-stage points aggressively at the camera with rapid lip-syncing to the fast Korean rap cadence. Side performers execute low arm pops and head nods. Neon server lights pulse in cyan and magenta behind them.
Stitch Note: Frame 360 latents serve as the visual anchor for Subgraph 2.

[0:15 - 0:30] Subgraph 2: Calling the Schema (Verse 1 Breakdown)
Audio Track: Driving synth bass; rap builds toward the pre-chorus lift.
Camera Motion: Low-angle whip-pan tracking left to right across the lineup.
Director Prompt: The camera pans low as the performers drop into a wide stance. The two lead dancers execute sweeping arm gestures, throwing neon energy toward the camera as they rap. The group performs synchronized stepping to the heavy bass drops, maintaining steady eye contact with the lens. Soft digital fog drifts through the alley floor.

[0:30 - 0:45] Subgraph 3: The Vault of Death (Pre-Chorus)
Audio Track: Soaring melodic vocal lift, building massive tension.
Camera Motion: Steady push-in toward the main vocalist, rising smoothly from chest to eye level.
Director Prompt: The vocalists perform open, expressive chest-level arm gestures as the vocal soaring lifts. The rest of the group sways in locked formation behind her, doing subtle hand pops on the snare hits. Neon glyphs and code columns float in the air around them as the camera rises smoothly.

[0:45 - 1:00] Subgraph 4: SELECT The Fire (Chorus 1)
Audio Track: Maximalist cyberpunk-rock explosion with heavy group chant.
Camera Motion: Dynamic orbital zoom circling the group.
Director Prompt: Full group chorus choreography. The 5 performers execute aggressive, high-energy K-pop dance routines with power stomps and wide arm extensions. Group vocal chants sync perfectly with wide mouth movements. Neon sparks shower from above as the background server racks flash red and gold to the rhythm.

nodes.title: 2nd minute notes
widgets_values:
Role & Directives: You are the master continuity director for a continuous 240-second animated music video sequence. Your job is to generate precise, highly descriptive video generation prompts while enforcing absolute, unyielding consistency across all blocks.

"Instruct performers to execute sharp arm, body, and stepping moves, but keep facial angles mostly oriented toward the camera lens to maintain face structure."

[1:00 - 1:15] Subgraph 5: Duplicate Row (Verse 2)
Audio Track: Gritty rolling bassline; fast, aggressive rap delivery.
Camera Motion: Fast forward push through the center line of the group.
Director Prompt: The beat drops to a gritty bassline as two members step into a front-and-center duet position. They perform ultra-fast staccato hand-tracking moves directly toward the camera lens with intense lip-sync precision. The three background members execute slow, rhythmic shoulder rolls.

[1:15 - 1:30] Subgraph 6: Korean Rap Break (Verse 2)
Audio Track: High-speed Korean rap break; frantic percussion.
Camera Motion: Rapid jitter-cam tracking closely with the lead rapper's hands.
Director Prompt: The lead rapper executes lightning-fast hand chops and finger-pointing toward the camera, mouth moving in precise sync with the rapid Korean lyrics. The surrounding dancers execute synchronized crouches and sharp direction shifts, building kinetic energy as the scene pulses with pink strobe flashes.

[1:30 - 1:45] Subgraph 7: Purge the Waste (Verse 2 Outro)
Audio Track: Heavy bass swells into the second chorus setup.
Camera Motion: Crane shot descending from high overhead down to eye level.
Director Prompt: The camera drops vertically from above as all 5 members lock into a unified triangular formation. They perform a sharp downward arm drop on the word "PURGE", followed by a synchronized slide step. Digital particles vanish in a vapor wave around their feet.

[1:45 - 2:00] Subgraph 8: Execution Flying (Chorus 2)
Audio Track: Full maximalist chorus repeat.
Camera Motion: Wide horizontal tracking shot sliding left to right.
Director Prompt: Maximum energy group dance performance. Synchronized jump-stepping and aggressive hand thrusts toward the camera. Background holographic data streams shatter into glowing embers as the performers sing the chorus in full unison.

nodes.title: 3rd minute notes
widgets_values:
Role & Directives: You are the master continuity director for a continuous 240-second animated music video sequence. Your job is to generate precise, highly descriptive video generation prompts while enforcing absolute, unyielding consistency across all blocks.

"Instruct performers to execute sharp arm, body, and stepping moves, but keep facial angles mostly oriented toward the camera lens to maintain face structure."

[2:00 - 2:15] Subgraph 9: GROUP BY Factions (Bridge)
Audio Track: 80s driving rock beat transition.
Camera Motion: Slow dramatic push-in on the 5 members walking forward together.
Director Prompt: The 5 performers walk forward in slow-motion unison toward the camera against a driving 80s synth-rock rhythm. They execute subtle, confident chest pops and head tilts to the beat, looking like database royalty taking over the server corridor.

[2:15 - 2:30] Subgraph 10: Database Kings (Bridge Outro)
Audio Track: Soaring synth-rock crescendo before the solo.
Camera Motion: Low-angle static hero shot with lighting sweeps.
Director Prompt: The group holds a powerful hero pose in a low-angle stance. The lead vocalist raises an arm toward the sky as volumetric spotlight beams sweep across the cyberpunk alley. Minor body sways keep the animation fluid as the track prepares for the instrument solo.

[2:30 - 2:45] Subgraph 11: Electric Shred (Solo Part 1)
Audio Track: Fast electric guitar solo kicks off with a heavy driving beat.
Camera Motion: Rapid alternating whip-pans from the left performers toward center stage.
Director Prompt: High-speed freestyle rock dance break. The performers on the left lead the motion, leaning back with aggressive power hand gestures and fast shoulder pops synced to the shredding guitar riffs. Neon lightning arcs across the server wall background as cyan light flashes to the beat.

[2:45 - 3:00] Subgraph 12: Hurdy-Gurdy Duel (Solo Part 2)
Audio Track: Hurdy-gurdy joins the guitar for a frantic, fast-tempo duel.
Camera Motion: Low-angle tracking shot slicing sharply from right to left across the lineup.
Director Prompt: The performers on the right side take the lead, executing rapid, synchronized arm chops and body drops matching the hurdy-gurdy rhythm. The center dancer throws an energetic power-point at the camera while the surrounding dancers execute fast, rhythmic bouncing steps in tight formation.

nodes.title: 4th minute notes
widgets_values:
Role & Directives: You are the master continuity director for a continuous 240-second animated music video sequence. Your job is to generate precise, highly descriptive video generation prompts while enforcing absolute, unyielding consistency across all blocks.

"Instruct performers to execute sharp arm, body, and stepping moves, but keep facial angles mostly oriented toward the camera lens to maintain face structure."

[3:00 - 3:15] Subgraph 13: Commit Transaction (Outro)
Audio Track: Music strips down to a heavy, pounding heartbeat rhythm; vocal chants echo out.
Camera Motion: Slow, deliberate push-in on the center lead while digital fog begins settling on the floor.
Director Prompt: The movement slows into deliberate, heavy-impact K-pop power poses. The performers execute synchronized, low-tempo chest pops and slow arm sweeps to the pounding heartbeat drum. Thick cyan smoke rolls across the floor as the background server lights dim down to a low pulse.

[3:15 - 3:30] Subgraph 14: Final Hit & Freeze (Final Frame)
Audio Track: Single monumental electronic hit followed by total silence.
Camera Motion: Smooth wide-angle zoom-out revealing the full 5-member lineup.
Director Prompt: All 5 performers step into a locked, unified hero formation as the camera pulls wide. On the final monumental electronic hit, they simultaneously throw a sharp strike gesture directly toward the camera and freeze instantly. A sudden blinding flash of cyan light fills the corridor, leaving them locked in silhouette as the smoke clears.
